items.title: BB holds policy rate on inflation risks, weak economy
items.description: The Bangladesh Bank (BB) has kept its main interest rate unchanged at 9.5 percent for the October-December quarter, saying inflation risks ahead are still large and the economy is weak.

items.title: Quarterly monetary policy: Is caution enough?
items.description: Bangladesh Bank’s first-ever quarterly Monetary Policy Statement is an important institutional change.

items.title: Tax on microsavings interest worries MFIs
items.description: A move by field offices of the National Board of Revenue (NBR) to collect tax on interest earned from microsavings has raised concerns among microfinance institutions (MFIs), which say the measure could discourage poor people from saving.

items.title: After jute, India seeks anti-dumping duty on PET film
items.description: India’s trade remedies authority has recommended definitive anti-dumping duties of up to $218 per tonne on imports of polyethylene terephthalate (PET) film, widely used in packaging, from Bangladesh for five years.

items.title: Bangla QR payments to get cheaper, faster for merchants
items.description: Bangladesh Bank has announced a series of measures to expand Bangla QR, the country’s interoperable QR payment standard, including lower merchant costs, instant settlement and incentives for financial institutions.

items.title: No edible oil price hike without scrutiny

items.title: Direct listing can deepen the capital market
items.description: Bangladesh’s capital market is at a point where meaningful reform is no longer an option; it is a necessity.
